title: Physics-Based Virtual Sensing Methodology for Estimating Mooring Line Tension in Floating Offshore Wind Turbines
titleKo: 부유식 해상풍력 터빈 계류 시스템 장력 추정을 위한 물리 기반 가상 센싱 방법론 연구
funder: Inha University New Faculty Research Grant, 2nd round
summary: This project develops Kalman-filter-based tension estimation from platform motion within a physics-based estimator framework.

title: Machine Learning-Based Tension Prediction for FOWT Mooring Lines
titleKo: 기계학습 기반 부유식 풍력터빈 계류선 인장력 예측
funder: Inha University New Faculty Research Grant, 1st round
summary: This project develops surrogate models that map platform response to mooring tension, providing a baseline against which to compare the physics-based estimators.

title: High-Efficiency Propeller Design for Operation in Both Polar and General Waters
titleKo: 극지/일반해역에서 겸용 가능한 고효율 프로펠러 설계기술 개발
funder: Korea Evaluation Institute of Industrial Technology
summary: This project develops high-efficiency propeller design technology suitable for operation across both polar and general-water conditions.

title: Analysis Model for Underwater Oxygen Supply in Marine Cages
titleKo: 해상가두리 수중산소 공급 분석 모델 개발
summary: This project develops an analysis model for underwater oxygen supply in marine aquaculture cages, with classification-society application in view.

title: BEACON for Future Marine Workforce: Integrating Spatial and Resource Utilization
titleKo: 지속가능한 해양 신산업 인재 양성을 위한 해양공간·자원 활용 연구
summary: This multi-year project integrates research and education in marine spatial and resource utilization to develop talent for sustainable emerging ocean industries.

title: Professional Human Resources Training for Digital Shipyard
funder: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (R&D)
summary: This multi-year programme develops specialist engineering talent for the digital transformation of shipyards.
